items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I think Johnny Don Ellis did the paintings.

ctx.x: Well, Dewdrop, you know, brought plenty of tracks in here. You know, like Big Joe Turner, all those kind of bars. Yeah, Dewdrop brought Donna Washington, all the people, big people there with the Dewdrop.
Yeah, they had nice paintings and everything. Remember I told you about that, huh? No. I think Johnny Don Ellis did the paintings.
